caption: The drawing features a central botanical motif composed of what appear to be blue leaves or fronds radiating from a single point. The leaves are clustered, with two larger, wing-like leaves extending outward and slightly downward on either side, and multiple smaller, upright leaves in the center, each with visible veining. The botanical elements are painted in varying shades of blue, ranging from light to dark, with the darkest blues used for shading and outlining veins. Above the plant motif, there is an oval number "6" and a stamped inscription in capital letters that reads: "COWDEN & WILCOX, HARRISBURG, PA." The background is a beige or light brown tone, with visible spots of discoloration and aged paper texture. The edges of the drawing are bordered by a wide, light-colored margin, and there is a faint, cursive signature in the lower right corner reading "Anna Rentzsch."
title: Jug
